pages.text: As you explore the world, you should find $(l:kingdomkeys:blox/prize)Prize Bloxes$(). These cubes can be mined with a pickaxe and have the chance to drop $(item)spells$(), $(l:kingdomkeys:customize/drive)Drive Forms$() and $(l:kingdomkeys:/syntheize/munny)Munny$().

When you equip these spells, they can be cast from your command menu, as long as you have the MP to cast them. If you run out of MP, it will take some time to recharge.$(p)You'll usually receive your $(thing)first MP with Level 4$(). Prior to that, you won't be able to cast any spells.
